candidates.entry: long DBC when 60d carry signal (implied yield from futures curve) > 0 AND 30d realized volatility < 15%
candidates.exit: exit when carry signal flips negative OR after 60d hold period
candidates.sizing: fixed position size targeting 10% annualized volatility based on 30d historical vol
candidates.regime_filter: skip when VIX > 25 OR 90d DBC volatility > 20%
candidates.rationale: Carry strategies in commodity futures have historically generated excess returns, especially in low volatility environments; this spec tests if DBC can capture similar dynamics.

candidates.entry: long PDBC when 120d momentum > 0 AND 60d momentum > 0
candidates.exit: exit when 60d momentum < 0 OR after 90d hold period
candidates.sizing: fixed position size targeting 10% annualized volatility based on 60d historical vol
candidates.regime_filter: skip when VIX > 30 OR 90d PDBC volatility > 25%
candidates.rationale: Momentum strategies have shown significant returns in commodity futures; this tests if PDBC can replicate past performance in trending markets.

candidates.entry: long DBA when 60d momentum > 0 during economic expansion (based on 6m moving average of ISM PMI > 50)
candidates.exit: exit when momentum < 0 OR economic regime shifts to recession (ISM PMI < 50)
candidates.sizing: risk-parity allocation targeting 8% annualized volatility based on 60d historical vol
candidates.regime_filter: skip during recession regime (ISM PMI < 50) OR when VIX > 30
candidates.rationale: Regime-dependent strategies outperform static ones; this tests if agricultural futures via DBA can exploit momentum in expansions.

candidates.entry: long USO when 90d momentum > 0 AND adjust position to target 10% annualized volatility
candidates.exit: exit when momentum < 0 OR after 120d hold period
candidates.sizing: dynamic sizing to maintain constant 10% annualized volatility based on 30d historical vol
candidates.regime_filter: skip when VIX > 35 OR 90d USO volatility > 30%
candidates.rationale: Volatility targeting improves risk-adjusted returns; this tests if USO can benefit from such an approach in energy futures.

candidates.entry: long GSG when 60d momentum > 0 AND 30d volatility < 15%
candidates.exit: exit when momentum < 0 OR after 90d hold period
candidates.sizing: fixed position size targeting 10% annualized volatility based on 30d historical vol
candidates.regime_filter: skip when VIX > 30 OR 90d GSG volatility > 25%
candidates.rationale: Diagnostic strategy to confirm potential no-edge in broad commodity ETFs like GSG due to increased market efficiency and reduced retail edge in futures markets post-2015.

notes_to_p3: Focus backtesting on 2020-2025 to evaluate if historical edges in commodity futures strategies (carry, momentum, regime-switching, volatility targeting) persist in ETFs like DBC, PDBC, and USO. Pay attention to transaction costs and slippage, as ETFs may not perfectly replicate futures returns. For the diagnostic strategy (GSG), assess if performance significantly underperforms historical benchmarks, confirming decayed edge in retail-accessible instruments.
